name: B10-0055/2024 (PPE) – The severe situation of political prisoners in Belarus
title: Resolution on the severe situation of political prisoners in Belarus
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of more than 1,300 people it says are held in Belarus for their politics, some in life-threatening conditions. It asks the European Union to widen sanctions on those responsible, to keep supporting Belarusian activists, and to prepare court cases against officials, including Aliaksandr Lukashenka. It also says prisoners must get medical help, lawyers, family visits and access to diplomats and international organisations. The text is a demand and a set of requests; it does not itself change any law.

- The EU is asked to widen sanctions and back court cases against Belarusian officials.
- It affects jailed activists and their families, and officials facing sanctions or prosecution.
- Next, the resolution goes to EU institutions and Belarusian representatives; no law changes directly.
